likedLine: Luci read the spec sheet twice. "Billed by the hour. Good."
dislikedLine: Luci slid the invoice back across. "That's a hobby, Operator."

likedLine: Mel laid a hand flat on the tank. "It's warm." She sounded surprised.
dislikedLine: Mel looked at the louvres. "That lets the outside in." She went to check the cultures.

likedLine: Bea knocked twice on the heat exchanger. "Hi." She was grinning.
dislikedLine: Bea looked at the genset for a while. Then she shut the door on it.

likedLine: Cass checked the gauges before she said anything. "Clean loop." She nodded.
dislikedLine: Cass held her mug well away from the turbine. "It's loud," she said. "And hot."
